fullDesc: In 1938 the foundation stone was laid for the Volkswagen factory in Germany to build a small people's car designed by Ferdinand Porsche. After World War II the Beetle was built in huge numbers and became a symbol of the 1960s.
realFacts: More than 21 million were built by 2003
It was a counterculture icon in the United States
A newer model, the New Beetle, appeared in 1998
